2,760 likes, 50 comments - houseofmisu on October 5, 2026: "I rarely throw a party, but when I do… I really do. 

For Sid’s 40-plus-1, I had a whole Speak easy,  Prohibition-era story playing out in my head and the food had to comply. If the theme was the song, the food was the rhythm …. And @specialityexperiences Hit every singe note perfectly. 

The carbonara. The lobster rolls. The grazing table. Everything was delightful . A night of unforgettable memories , happy bellies and hearts full Of love. 

Ps : Happy 41 my love . You were worth pulling out all the stops for 🥹🖤".
